Interface Storage

All Known Subinterfaces:
KeyedStorage, PlayerStorage
All Known Implementing Classes:
EphemeralStorage, VirtualStorage
public interface Storage
Where items live: get, set, size and markDirty.

Storage does not know who owns it, when to save, or which player it belongs to. Those belong to CustomContainerMenu or a binding registry.

When slots are built, each Storage is wrapped in vanilla's Container interface (StorageContainerAdapter). Consumers see only Storage.

For persistent storage (on a block entity, a player or an item), see StorageAttachment, whose factories produce Storage views backed by Fabric attachments or data components that save themselves. For session-only storage, see EphemeralStorage. For virtual observer views, see VirtualStorage.
